storage: Airtight jar at room temperature, dry and away from the stove: 6–12 months. In monsoon months, keep large stock in the fridge or add a few dried red chillies to deter weevils. Soaked beans: cook within 12 hours. Cooked dal makhani keeps 3 days in the fridge and freezes well for about 1 month.
looksLike: Small, shiny, jet-black oval beans with a tiny white "eye"; cream-white inside when broken. Cooked, they turn creamy and slightly gelatinous.
shelfLife: About 9–12 months sealed (check the best-before date). Very old beans take much longer to soften.
substitutes: Urad chilka (split black urad with skin)

usedIn.raw: 40 g raw (3 level tbsp, about ⅕ cup)
